item.description:
Release v5.6.0

Changes since v5.5.0

  • document: update documentation
  • feat: add VerbosityEnvironment extension and refine token plan UI
  • feat: change NewChatButton to deselect conversation and add placeholder view
  • feat(activity-heatmap): add info button for token usage explanation
  • feat(agent-runner): stream assistant tokens via sendStreaming with throttled deltas
  • feat(conversation): reassign empty conversations to the new project on switch
  • feat(ConversationListPlugin): add multi-line display for conversation items
  • feat(factory): adapt rail and bottom tabs to per-container API
  • feat(kernel): add message-streaming lifecycle event and dispatcher
  • feat(kernel): add MessageStreaming protocol and registration plumbing
  • feat(layout-plugin): add read-only settings view for layout state
  • feat(layout-plugin): persist rail tabs and visibility overrides with auto-save
  • feat(layout): make rail tabs per-container and add visibility override system
  • feat(llm-minimax): move response parsing to background task and add Sendable conformance
  • feat(lumi): add ErrorView and show it when kernel.layoutManager is nil
  • feat(LumiKernel): add conversationManager service accessor
  • feat(LumiKernel): add coordinator skeleton for intra-kernel orchestration
  • feat(message-list): render streaming assistant tokens as a live typewriter row
  • feat(message-list): show a shimmering skeleton while messages load
  • feat(message-managing): exclude tool messages from paging by default
